title: Lease-End Plan Installments for Customers with a Paid-Off Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contract
content:
**Relationship schedule — balloon tenure and the Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease end-of-term plan**

**Clause.** The balloon-tenure installments added to a lease-end installment plan on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease are 2 (the long balloon-tenure installments) when the customer holds a paid-in-full Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract whose payments made count is at least 48 (the long balloon-tenure payment count); 1 (the mid balloon-tenure installment) when that count is at least 24 (the mid balloon-tenure payment count) but below 48; and none when the customer holds no paid-in-full Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract or its count is below 24. Where the customer's balloon records list more than one paid-in-full contract, the first one listed is the one read. The installments are added to the plan's number of installments before the plan balance is divided.

| Paid-in-full balloon contract (first listed) | Payments made count | Installments added |
|---|---|---|
| held | 60 | 2 |
| held | 48 | 2 |
| held | 47 | 1 |
| held | 24 | 1 |
| held | 23 | none |
| only an active balloon contract, or none | — | none |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lessee whose earlier Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract was paid in full after 36 payments has 1 installment added to the plan.
